reason: An Android mobile shell for DeepSeek Harness that embeds a Termux-based runtime, presents a WebView agent UI, provides a bash console, bridges file access, and manages the engine lifecycle and runtime updates.

summaries.zh: 为 Android 提供 DeepSeek Harness 移动端壳应用，内嵌 Termux 运行时并通过 WebView 提供智能体界面、Bash 终端和文件访问桥接。
summaries.en: An Android shell for DeepSeek Harness that embeds a Termux runtime and provides a WebView agent interface, Bash terminal, and file-access bridge.

capabilities: Runs an embedded web agent with bash, Node.js, coreutils, and plugins
Accesses selected directories through the Android Storage Access Framework
Downloads and replaces runtime snapshots from an online manifest
Maintains and restarts a background engine service
